richergangue-steel-seam.notes: An added gangue wash outcome: a seam of metal, one 4 kg seam chunk (this add-on's own item) and 9 kg of washed tailings. Same charge and time as the gangue wash, so it can join its outcome table. No revision is written: Framework derives a stable one from the id.

richergangue-chunk-break.notes: A use for the added item: the V4 breaks one seam chunk into four of the game's scrap steel. Mass in equals mass out.
